$Comment: The Costume Wand: point it at another player and dress them up. Primary puts on the Jack Skeleton costume (Hallows_Eve_Costume_Wand_Cast), Secondary the Lost Soul (Hallows_Eve_Costume_Wand_Cast_Soul); both share the one five-second cooldown Hallows_Eve_Costume_Wand. It dresses only another player, who can take the costume off with /zigcostume off, and a costume that lands counts as USE_ITEM with the Qualifier Costume for the player who cast it. Worn on the game's wood wand model with this pack's texture.
